items.label: ORIGINAL BASEBOARD BUDDY
items.value: Baseboard Buddy is the quick solution for cleaning baseboards, moldings & trim throughout your home; With its smart, user-friendly design, it's easier than ever to keep your home & hard-to-reach areas dust-free & clean.

items.label: NO BENDING OR STRAINING
items.value: The lightweight, heavy-duty aluminum handle extends up to 4 feet, making it easy to reach high or low areas without bending or stretching; Its ergonomic design & flexible plastic head make baseboard & molding cleaning easy.

items.label: WALK & GLIDE WITH EASE
items.value: The flexible head of this wall mop adapts to the shape of your baseboards, door moldings & more, while the 360° swivel action allows you to clean effortlessly from any angle making this cleaning tool a household essential.

items.label: WET OR DRY
items.value: Baseboard Buddy works great with or without water, its textured cleaning pads trap and lock in dust, dirt, and grime; Perfect for reaching & cleaning a variety of surfaces like chair rails, banisters, mantels, wood, tile, laminate & more!

items.label: WHAT’S INCLUDED
items.value: Comes with 1 Baseboard Buddy cleaning tool & 3 reusable microfiber cleaning pads; The washable pads are designed to be long-lasting, making cleanup efficient and cost-effective, simply rinse and reuse for multiple cleaning sessions.

items.label: Item Type Name
items.value: Includes 1 Baseboard Buddy and 3 Baseboard Buddy Pads
